summary: A weekly house-hosted board game night at Hi-Wire Brewing's RAD Beer Garden taproom, part of the venue's regular weekly programming alongside 'Mug Mondays' and 'Trivia Tuesdays'. It's an open drop-in activity using the taproom's own game shelf plus BYO games, with no club name, membership, dues, or named organizer beyond the brewery itself.

evidence.note: Every one of the 29 weekly listings uses identical boilerplate: 'An open and casual game night featuring an assortment of board games available to play. Guests are welcome to bring their own games to share' - no membership or club language.
Tags are dominated by drop-in/walk-in language ('Drop In Play', 'Walk Ins Welcome', 'Casual Drop In', 'Open Play', 'Bring Your Own Game') rather than community/membership terms.

Hi-Wire's own site frames RAD Beer Garden as a taproom with regular weekly promotions (Mug Mondays, Trivia Tuesdays, etc.), consistent with Board Game Night being house programming rather than an independent club.

A separate 'Social Game Night' also held at this venue is run by the Meetup group 'Asheville 20's and 30's Social Group' and explicitly aimed at newcomers making new friends - confirms the venue hosts rotating-public game nights from outside organizers rather than having its own game-night club, and this Meetup organizer is distinct from the recurring MountainX-listed event being evaluated.

No Facebook group, Discord, newsletter, or 'members' page specific to a board game club at Hi-Wire RAD turned up in search; the venue's Facebook page (facebook.com/hiwirebrewingRAD) is the general brewery page, not a game-night community page.
